text_simplified: Parents must teach their children the rights of others and not to take their toys or belongings without permission. They should also guide their children to respect the property of others and avoid encroaching upon it. This behavior strengthens moral values (akhlaq) and sound tarbiyah.

review_defects.why: The Arabic says 'moral values' without the term 'akhlaq'; adding it introduces an Islamic term not present in the source, potentially altering nuance.
